programme.title: REPLAY: 2023 Rose Bowl Utah vs Penn State
programme.desc: Penn State defeated Utah 35-21 in the 2023 Rose Bowl, pulling away in the second half with two explosive touchdowns of over 80 yards. programme.title: REPLAY: 2020 Rose Bowl Oregon vs Wisconsin
programme.desc: Oregon defeated Wisconsin 28-27 in a tight 2020 Rose Bowl game marked by six lead changes and key turnovers. Oregon quarterback Justin Herbert scored three rushing touchdowns, including the game-winner, while the Ducks defense forced four turnovers to secure the victory.

programme.desc: Oakmont isn’t just one of the most historic courses in golf — it’s home to one of the most exclusive clubhouses in American sports. - Ahead of the 125th U.S. Open Championship, we step inside the walls of Oakmont Country Club — a place steeped in U.S. Open history, whispered legends, and decades of golf’s most iconic moments. From the original locker room that held Hogan’s shoes to the trophies that shaped golf’s golden era, this is a rare look at the soul of championship golf. - Drone Footage Courtesy USGA - Photos Provided By Oakmont Country Club

programme.title: REPLAY: 2019 Rose Bowl Ohio State vs Washington
programme.desc: Ohio State defeated Washington 28-23 in the 2019 Rose Bowl, holding off a furious Huskies' fourth-quarter comeback to seal the win. Quarterback Dwayne Haskins threw for three first-half touchdowns in Urban Meyer's final game as the Buckeyes' head coach, who retired after the victory.
